# Fukuii

> Fukuii is a Scala execution client for Ethereum and the EVM ecosystem. Feature-complete, sovereign-grade, open source, from solo operators to sovereign funds.

Fukuii is the only Scala EVM execution client, maintained by Chippr Robotics LLC.
One binary runs Ethereum Classic (chain 61), Ethereum mainnet (chain 1), Mordor testnet
(chain 63), Sepolia (chain 11155111), and Holesky from a single deployment.

## Why Fukuii

### The Preferred Stack

A type system that rejects consensus bugs before they reach a block. Serious infrastructure
runs on the JVM, the runtime trading desks and clearing systems have trusted for decades, and
its operational tooling (JFR, async-profiler, JMX, heap dumps) comes for free. Fukuii goes
one layer further. Scala 3's algebraic data types, exhaustive pattern matching, and type
system make entire classes of consensus-critical bugs impossible to express, caught at compile
time rather than discovered in production. The JVM is the foundation; Scala is why correctness
is structural.

### Independent by Construction

Running a node independent of the dominant implementation changes the risk profile at the
network layer. Fukuii shares the EIPs and wire protocol but nothing else: different codebase,
different language, different team, different failure modes. A consensus bug in a Go
implementation does not propagate to a JVM implementation, and vice versa.

### Agentic Infrastructure

Model Context Protocol is an open standard that lets AI agents call structured tools. Fukuii
ships an MCP server that exposes node state, sync progress, peer counts, and block data to
any MCP-compatible agent. Infrastructure automation, anomaly detection, and runbook execution
wire straight into a running node.

## Supported Networks

- Ethereum Classic (chain 61): PoW/Ethash, full SNAP sync, Olympia fork
- Mordor (chain 63): ETC PoW testnet
- Ethereum Mainnet (chain 1): PoS via Engine API V1-V4
- Sepolia (chain 11155111): PoS testnet
- Holesky: PoS testnet
- Private/consortium chains: custom genesis, no source modification required

## Runtime Stack

- Language: Scala 3.3.8 LTS (June 2026 patch)
- JDK: OpenJDK 25 LTS (current LTS, September 2025)
- Actor system: Apache Pekko 1.6.0 (Apache Software Foundation, no BSL)
- Storage: RocksDB 10.10.1.1 (Meta 10.x series, late 2025)
- Effects: Cats Effect 3 + fs2 (fully migrated off Monix)
- SLSA Level 3 provenance: Cosign keyless signing on every release
- CycloneDX SBOM on all release artifacts

## Hardware Requirements

- Home node: 8 GB RAM, 500 GB disk
- Professional: 16 GB RAM, 1 TB disk
- Enterprise: 32-64 GB RAM, 2-4 TB disk
- Archive: 64 GB+ RAM, 4 TB+ disk

## Quick Start

    docker run ghcr.io/chippr-robotics/fukuii --network mordor

## Orbita Roadmap

Fukuii's architecture is evolving toward a multi-instance, consensus-agnostic runtime: one
process, multiple chains, with isolated state and network stacks per network. The end state
is an execution layer that runs any EVM chain, not just the ones it was compiled for.

Phase 1 (In Progress): fukuii-env, one binary and multiple network environments, declarative
chain definitions loaded at runtime without recompilation.

Phase 2 (Planned): Multi-instance runtime, single process manages ETC and ETH concurrently,
shared EVM runtime with isolated state and network stack per chain.

Phase 3 (Planned): Checkpoint consensus (Orbita PoA), pluggable consensus module enabling
PoA sidechain checkpointing to a parent chain.

Phase 4 (Planned): OP-style derivation, L2 block derivation from L1 batches and blobs,
Fukuii as the execution layer for OP-compatible rollups.
